DIVORCE SCAM

By: Nicky Troll | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Summary:
For some the excitement of getting divorced is even greater than getting hitched in the first place. But getting the knot undone can often cost you more than the wedding in the first place. This opens the door for opportunistic crooks to swindle desperate couples wanting a get divorced.

We catch an unscrupulous con woman charges R1800 bucks promising a divorce in just two weeks! She delivers! But wait, it's a fake document!

We expose her - outing her scam on camera!


Further information:
CASE STUDY 1:
Johanne Ingram - wanted to get divorced last year - came across an ad on Facebook. Eliza Lazarus offers divorces for R1800 cash - done and dusted in two weeks. But after getting the divorce order, sending it to her now ex-husband she learnt that it wasn't valid - it was a fake document!


CASE STUDY 2:
Yolanda Gouws and her new fiance were both separated from their legal spouses - wanting to tie the knot, they need to get their separations made official. Both couples had come to an agreement, so they presumed the process would be simple - R3600 for two divorces later, they thought everything was on track for their new life together. But they too would soon fined out that they would be swindled.


The document looks legit, but is fake - the case number is fake, often the details of the magistrate is in correct - ultimately it's all invalid and the couples are still married.

LAWYER Anthony Huriwitzz - tested it out and asked Elizma to divorce two people that weren't even married - three weeks later the document arrived - again another fake divorce order - this time for two people that weren't even married.

Press Release:


Divorce Scamster
Just a week before your next wedding you’re shocked to find out you are still legally married. You double-check your divorce certificate and all seems legit. It’s even been stamped by the registrar of the High Court. But could a clever con artist have faked your divorce documents? Carte Blanche follows the devastating trail of a skillful swindler selling desperate couples a shortcut to quick, cheap and fake divorce documents.


Script:


STRUCTURE

VO: For some the happiest day of their lives is not the day they tied the knot to their so-called soulmate… instead, the excitement of getting divorced is far greater than getting hitched in the first place.

LINK: Choosing to split up easier said than done for most married couples, getting divorced legally is a complicated process

VO: It could end up costing you more than the wedding itself! Unless you enlist the services of a real life fairy con mother.

JOHANNE: R1800 sounds like a bloody bargain, I was like ok, I’ve won the jackpot here .

VO: Johanne Ingram stumbled across one of Elizma Lazarus’ adverts on Facebook offering quick and cheap divorces.

JOHANNE: I phoned her and she seemed fine and I got her whatsapp and her picture was there, and she was informed. She seemed legit.

LINK: This is Elizma’s ad on Facebook, R1800 for an uncontested divorce and it should take between one and two weeks – it’s a big sell and not easy to pull off – it does sound to good to be true.

VO: But in true fairy con mother style, Elizma achieved the impossible for Johanne – producing this divorce order just two days later!

JOHANNE: It all looked fine, other than that it was in Afrikaans, but I didn’t worry too much about it – as far as I was concerned she was wonderful, I paid a cheap fee for my divorce and I was divorced.

ANTHONY: For an unopposed divorce should be in the region of R5000 to R10000 //If I charged R1800 for work I wouldn’t be able to survive.

VO: Attorney Anthony Hurwitz was asked to certify a copy of Johanne’s divorce order.

ANTHONY: On the face of it, it looks like a real divorce order, it’s got the court emblem, it’s got a case number, it’s got the Judge’s name and it’s got the parties names // So to me it looked like a valid court order.

VO: But it wasn’t, it's a fraudulent document! Concerned that he had certified a forged court order, Anthony began to investigate.

ANTHONY: The matter was not on the court roll for that day. So on the face of it, from what I could see, this matter did not exist, this divorce never happened –. INT 1 M15

JOHANNE: // I was so excited to be divorced. Just to find out two weeks later that I wasn’t – // she made me feel like an idiot and she took my money. INT 3 M7

VO: The reality is this divorce order isn’t even worth the paper it’s printed on.

On closer inspection.

- Judge Peffo does not exist – it is in face Judge Teffo with a T!
- Monday, the 10th of August 2015 was a public holiday, following women’s day on the 9th.

VO: Judge President Dunstan Mlambo of the High Court Gauteng Division – says it’s not limited to fraudulent divorce orders, this is not an isolated case - criminals are worming their way into the legal system.

JP MLAMBO: It just shows that the rot in our society is deepening about people thinking they can use justice institutions to rubber stamp their criminal activities. INT 1 M17

VO: Keen to test the scam, Anthony set up an alias and contacted Elizma. He used the names of two people who had the same surname but were not married.

ANTHONY: I sent her an email that I am unhappy in my marriage, I believe she does divorces, she responded maybe 5 minutes later. // INT 2 M2

VO: He deposited R1800 and a couple of weeks, later Elizma produced this divorce order – she had managed to divorce two people who weren’t even married! She’s that GOOD!

DEVI: So as money making schemes go, this is pretty simple
ANTHONY: Very simple, very easy to make a quick buck – and there’s not much work involved in this. It’s a matter of drawing up documents and sending them on.
DEVI: Cut and paste?
ANTHONY: Cut and paste. INT 1 M26

DEVI: Are you surprised how real these documents look?
JP MLAMBO: // I do not rule out inside involvement in these things, because sometimes we look at some of the court orders, they reflect some of stuff, people’s names, I am surpised that is seems to be rife, // INT 1 M7

VO: We wanted to meet the lady behind these mircal divorces ourselves and sent in an undercover operative under the guise of wanting a divorce.

She claims to understands the legal process.

ELIZMA: I give these to the advocate…

VO: In fact, she says she got it down pat…

ELIZMA: Ek doen al die papier werk en alles so,
PRODUCER: Jy doen al die schelp werk.
ELIZMA: Ek het al die templates, ek copy en paste sommer net.

VO: And Elizma is not shy to say the divorce business is booming.

ELIZMA: Ek doen so 6 ‘n week
PRODUCER: Ses ‘n week?
ELIZMA: en rof weg maak ek so R25000 ‘n wee.. ‘n maand. CLIP7573 M1


VO: Elizma’s business was not restricted to Gauteng. Her adverts, along with her fake divorce orders had even reached Kimberly in the Northern Cape.

Lizelle Bristow had to postpone her wedding plans to her new found love, when she learnt her divorce order was fake.

LIZELLE: I was in tears, really I was in tears, because at that stage it was very traumatic already. And then I wanted to get all this nonsense behind me. // INT 1 M11
DEVI: how did you feel having to tell people that the wedding is off because you are still married.
LIZELLE: It was horrible, it was a horrible thing. INT 1 M23

VO: Anthony reported the cases to the authorities – but they already knew of Elizma and her fake divorces.

ANTHONY: In fact they’ve told me that there are six that they know of. INT 1 M21

JP MLAMBO: // I escalated the matter to General Hendricks who is in charge from SAPS to say there has been very slow action on their part, // It’s one of those matters where we feel the police should have made arrests already, because all the evidence is there already. INT 1 M19 // INT 1 M25

VO: One piece of evidence that suggests inside court involvement, is the registrar’s stamp – all three documents bear the same name: T.J van Zyl.

DEVI: is there a TJ van Zyl and have there been discussions with him about how his stamp ended up on a fraudulent document?
JP MLAMBO: yes, we have a registrar by the name of Tobie van Zyl // he has disowned the signature because he was able to show to us the features thereof that are not his and when he demonstrated his signature it’s clear to us that his signature on these court order is forged. INT 1 M9

VO: Comparing the documents there is a definite difference in the signatures.

LINK: We’re on our way to see Elizma Lazarus who lives in the Norht of Pretoria, we’re on our way to say hello and ask her just how does she do this? LINK INTO BUST

ELIZMA: you say they got it from me? I don’t know this surname.
DEVI: All from you. M3

VO: ELIZMA’s memory failed her… she couldn’t remember of any of these clients….

DEVI: In fact these two people here – the Meyers, aren’t even married to each other but you divorced them – how did you pull that off?
ELIZMA: I don’t know a Meyers either – I’ve got all my clients, I’ve got.
DEVI: This was deposited into your bank account…
ELIZMA: Johan Meyers… M4

VO: Odd that she can’t remember - Johan Meyers was the alias Anthony had used in all his correspondence with Elizma spanning over a month.

DEVI: Are you aware that these fake divorce documents?
ELIZMA: No, because I get it from Rudi
DEVI: Who is Rudi now?
ELIZMA: Rudi is the advocate that works with the cases. Rudi van Vuuren.
DEVI: What do you do with Rudi?
ELZIMA: I give him the documents, he handles everything and gives the final divorce order to me. M 5
DEVI: These are not valid case numbers, these are not vaild dates, this is not judge, this not a valid piece of paper – none of them that you’ve done are valid.
ELIZMA: So I’ll have to take it up with him.

VO: Realising we were on to her… she decided to walk away…

OUT LINK: So Elizma is denying complete responsibility here and says it’s Rudi’s fault // bottom line – she collects the money, R1800 per divorce, and it’s fake.

VO: It’s not the first time that Elizma blamed her so-called associate Rudi van Vuuren.

LIZELLE: she blames Rudi, she never she had him as a partner, there are lots problems, but she’ll pay me the money back – I never got the money back. INT 1 M8

LINK: We tried to call Rudi over a period of days, but our calls go directly to voice mail, we’ve managed to establish that this telephone number isn’t registered to a Rudi or Van Vuuren. RUDI

VO: While Elizma claims that she meets Rudi at the High Court in Pretoria, we’ve established that there is no one by such a name registered with the Law Society.

DEVI: Do you think Rudi exists?
LIZELLE: No, today what I know now, Rudi doesn’t exist, I think it’s just her – me, myself and I. INT 1 M27

VO: Judge President Mlambo believes the stamps could be coming from outside the courts.

JP MLAMBO: we warned the registrars that they need to guard those stamps // because once that stamp is used on a document their heads will be on the block. //it’s people making those stamps, they come and they get document that is stamped properly, they look at the stamp and then they copy it. Int 1 M15// INT 1 M13

VO: We set out to see how difficult it would be to have our own Registrar of the High Court Stamp made. Posing as an attorney, we found one shop on the East Rand willing to assist.

STAMP UNDERCOVER UPSOUND:

LINK: R685 later we were able to collect our stamp the next day. Let’s see what they have to say for themselves.

GWEN: No, no , no
DEVI: Today is your day… here is the receipt…

VO: Gwen said times are tough and she is struggling financially,

DEVI: Let me explain the reprecussions… murders bail… fake divorces… any idea what damage it does for R685…

VO: With no sign of Rudi, Elizma has some explaining to do.

DEVI: There is no Rudi as far as I am concerned…
ELIZMA: Ja, but that’s what you say.
DEVI: // You’re selling divorces that don’t even exist? // no one knows Rudi, no one sees Rudi, maybe he’s a figment of your imagination and he doesn’t exist.
ELIZMA: ag, please – I don’t need to talk to you, the lawyer says I don’t need to talk you.
DEVI: now you have a lawyer? ELISMA CALL 3 M2
CUTS CALL

ANTHONY: she knows what she’s doing, and I imagine she knows what she’s doing is wrong – it’s money for nothing. INT 2 M6









PROMOS


PROMO 15

VO: Carte Blanche catches the con-woman behind a fraudulent divorce order scam – taking cash for forged documents.

DEVI: the Meyers, aren’t even married to each other but you divorced them – how did you pull that off?

PROMO 15
VO: An opportunistic con-woman swindles desperate couples wanting a quick divorced.

JOHANNE: // I was so excited to be divorced. Just to find out two weeks later that I wasn’t – // she made me feel like an idiot and she took my money. INT 3 M7

VO: Carte Blanche investigates.



PROMO 20
VO: Criminals worm their way into the legal system with fraudulent court orders.

JP MLAMBO: People thinking they can use justice institutions to rubber stamp their criminal activities. INT 1 M17

metadata.Summary: For some the excitement of getting divorced is even greater than getting hitched in the first place. But getting the knot undone can often cost you more than the wedding in the first place. This opens the door for opportunistic crooks to swindle desperate couples wanting a get divorced. We catch an unscrupulous con woman charges R1800 bucks promising a divorce in just two weeks! She delivers! But wait, it's a fake document! We expose her - outing her scam on camera!
metadata.Further information: CASE STUDY 1: Johanne Ingram - wanted to get divorced last year - came across an ad on Facebook. Eliza Lazarus offers divorces for R1800 cash - done and dusted in two weeks. But after getting the divorce order, sending it to her now ex-husband she learnt that it wasn't valid - it was a fake document! CASE STUDY 2: Yolanda Gouws and her new fiance were both separated from their legal spouses - wanting to tie the knot, they need to get their separations made official. Both couples had come to an agreement, so they presumed the process would be simple - R3600 for two divorces later, they thought everything was on track for their new life together. But they too would soon fined out that they would be swindled. The document looks legit, but is fake - the case number is fake, often the details of the magistrate is in correct - ultimately it's all invalid and the couples are still married. LAWYER Anthony Huriwitzz - tested it out and asked Elizma to divorce two people that weren't even married - three weeks later the document arrived - again another fake divorce order - this time for two people that weren't even married.
